claim.text: Research comparisons, ablations, and human-presented prose do not by themselves certify independent human origination of ideas or independent scientific validity.
claim.scope: Scientific research artifacts and provenance; worked CluSTER example only
assumptions: Publication and repository artifacts do not reveal all design decisions
forbidden_promotions: Do not infer AI authorship from style or recombination
Do not promote a toy counterexample to an audited implementation defect
Do not call this audit independent replication

specification.intended_object: Typed separation of intellectual provenance, theoretical adequacy, empirical validity, and evidence independence
invariants: A generated narrative is not itself a new external witness
Evidence must be connected to exact claims and assumptions
A theory for uniform selection does not automatically apply to deterministic peripheral selection
known_answer_cases: For gradients (0,0,10), the full cluster mean equals 10/3 and the selected farthest-point mean equals 10
A source citation can be true even if an AI wrote the literature review
A human reviewer can share the originating model's assumptions

implementation.environment: Static GitHub connector inspection; no training run
implementation.representation: Markdown evidence ledger, JSON manifest; API gate heuristics

metric.name: Claim-relative evidence assessment, no empirical aggregate score
metric.units: provenance status, theorem assumptions, performance measure, witness independence
equivalence_attacks: Paraphrased vs verbatim research explanation must not alter validity inference
Reordered samples and permuted cluster labels should preserve claimed conclusions
Changing nominal human/agent reviewer labels must not automatically change independence

black_box: Not executed; future source-code check of CluSTER selection path
structural: Inspected README, PRINCIPLES, EVIDENCE, FALSIFIERS, gate_substance, service, independence tests
property_based: Not executed; optional candidate within-cluster permutation invariance
metamorphic: Analytic toy gradient (0,0,10) vs farthest-point selection
fuzzing: Existing ACAF checks documented; not executed as part of this audit
historical: Existing Experiment 001 remains a preregistered unexecuted design pilot

matched_baselines: Matched-data-budget random baseline for future performance tests
negative_controls: False source references and generated synthetic logs must not be promoted
Human author of prose but shared model-generated design path
Identical science described with opposite authorship labels
controls.compute_parity: Future independent performance replication must separately match or measure selection cost and training cost
controls.sampling_parity: Equal data budgets and seeds for each control
controls.data_access_parity: Use the same raw datasets and evaluation splits; no extra oracle information

preregistration.prediction: Evidence independence and authorship provenance remain undecidable from polished prose and internal review artifacts alone.
preregistration.primary_metric: No effectiveness metric measured; next test is exact fixed-state gradient discrepancy under the selected policy
preregistration.uncertainty_method: Exact arithmetic for toy case; empirical confidence intervals and replication required for performance claims
preregistration.kill_condition: A verified code path, valid correction, or different exact theorem target invalidates the claimed theory-to-code mismatch
preregistration.stop_condition: Do not infer AI authorship or empirical speedup from toy demonstration; do not start a new broad effectiveness trial before Experiment 001's stop rule is resolved
preregistration.promotion_rule: Only inspectable source-to-implementation correspondence may support a bounded mismatch, and only external replication may support general efficacy

execution_records: No code or benchmarks executed; static repository inspection and analytic arithmetic only
claim_to_artifact_map: Version-specific headline -> arXiv and ACL anthology abstract
AI-origin claim -> no authorship provenance artifact

preserved: Four distinct questions: validity, novelty, independence, origin
Separation of gate substance and ceremony

transformed: Static inspection; no executable research reproduction

lost: No estimate of paper effect or authorship

preserved: Unresolved questions not treated as proven

result.observed: Repository correctly disclaims substantive gate assessment. An evidence-lineage concern remains open. An exact scalar toy example disproves automatic unbiasedness transfer from uniform to peripheral sampling in general.
result.effect_size: Not applicable: no framework effectiveness or CluSTER performance test executed
result.uncertainty: Structural inspection plus exact arithmetic only; any paper-specific methodological attribution remains provisional
retired_claims: Presentation quality and ablations alone rule out substantial AI contribution
AI-generated literature comparisons are automatically invalid
active_remainder: Inspect full implementation for any valid sampling correction
Find independent provenance witnesses before concluding idea origin
Complete Experiment 001 before claims about framework effectiveness
